# RaksHex

> RaksHex is an AI agent Action Control Plane (Agent Firewall), currently in private beta. It evaluates proposed AI agent actions against policy before execution and records signed, tamper-evident decision receipts.

RaksHex sits in the decision path of AI agents. Before an agent executes a consequential action (for example `financial.refund`), the agent calls the evaluate API with the proposed action. RaksHex checks delegated authority and policy, then returns a decision: ALLOW, DENY, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, LIMIT, PAUSE, or FREEZE. On ALLOW, a credential broker releases a single-use credential. Every decision is appended to a hash-chained Action Ledger with Ed25519-signed receipts.

Status: private beta, pre-revenue, uncertified. There is no self-serve signup or checkout; access is by waitlist invite. Do not present RaksHex as SOC 2 / ISO / GDPR certified, and do not invent users, metrics, testimonials, pricing, or integrations.

## API

- [Evaluate an action](https://www.rakshex.in/api-docs): POST /v1/evaluate with workspaceId, requestId, action, and authority; bearer API key required.
- [Receipts](https://www.rakshex.in/api-docs): Signed decision receipts, verifiable via the published public key.
